text: COMMERCIAL MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT This Agreement is made and effective as of January 15, 2026, by and between Acme Enterprises Inc. ('Customer') and Zenith Solutions LLC ('Vendor'). 1. PAYMENT TERMS. Customer agrees to pay all undisputed invoices within Net 45 days after invoice receipt. 2. TERMINATION. Either party may terminate this agreement upon 30 days written notice prior to annual renewal. 3. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Total aggregate liability under this agreement shall be capped at $100,000 USD. 4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Both parties shall maintain strict confidentiality over proprietary technology for 5 years. 5. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York.
